Newmont’s 2005 Stock Incentive Plan was approved by the stockholders on April 27,
2005. A maximum of 20,000,000 shares of Newmont’s Common Stock were authorized to be issued under this plan. Out of this maximum number of shares, no more than 10,000,000 shares may be awarded as restricted stock or other stock-based awards and
no more than 1,000,000 shares may be awarded as non-employee director stock awards.
